## Requested Remedy

We request that Meridian Community Health Plan overturn the denial of claim 6268311 and approve coverage for the lumbar spine MRI (CPT 72148) performed on 2026-06-18 for patient Brenda Wilson (P-1862). The clinical record demonstrates that the service meets all medical necessity criteria under policy MP-IMG-007.

## Clinical Basis for Appeal

The denial letter states that the clinical information submitted did not demonstrate that the service met the plan's medical necessity criteria (source: docs/denial_letter.txt). However, the clinical record on file satisfies every criterion in policy MP-IMG-007:

**Criterion 2.1(a) — At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy prior to the MRI request (MET).**
The primary care visit note of 2026-03-23 documents initiation of conservative management with NSAIDs, a home exercise program, and a physical therapy referral (source: notes/2026-03-23_pcp.txt). The follow-up note of 2026-04-13 documents ongoing physical therapy (source: notes/2026-04-13_pcp_followup.txt). The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 states that conservative management failed to provide adequate relief and that the MRI was ordered at that visit (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt). The physical therapy attendance log documents 21 visits from 2026-03-23 through 2026-06-04, a treatment period of 73 days (approximately 10 weeks), which exceeds the 6-week requirement (source: supporting/pt_log.txt).

**Criterion 2.1(b) — A neurological deficit or recognized red flag finding documented in the clinical record (MET).**
The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 documents left leg paresthesias, a positive straight leg raise at 40 degrees, and mildly reduced left ankle dorsiflexion strength (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt). These are documented neurological findings supporting medical necessity.

**Criterion 2.1(c) — No prior imaging of the same lumbar spine region within the preceding 12 months (MET).**
The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 states: "No prior lumbar imaging on file" (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt).

## Deadline

The appeal deadline under policy MP-IMG-007 (section 7.1) is 180 days from the date of the claim determination notice. The notice date is 2026-07-17, making the appeal deadline 2027-01-13. This appeal is submitted on 2026-08-04, which is within the deadline (deadline_ok: true).
